title: cli: `os plugin publish` and `readOspluginManifest` still hand-parse the compiled manifest, a third door outside the one `ManifestSchema` parse #27686 gives install and boot
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① the same defect class as #27686 at a door that card's ruling did not name, found by the contract review of PR #27791 (#27686), record 6511494551 ("noted, no fix"). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4 · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

**Business reason.** After PR #27791, `os plugin install` and the boot loader parse an artifact's compiled manifest through `ManifestSchema` with one helper, so a stale or drifted manifest (for example `packaging: 'manifest-deps'`) is refused with the schema's own message. `os plugin publish` still reads the same manifest with a bare `JSON.parse`, so a stale artifact can be published to a registry and only fails later, at its consumer's install, instead of at the publisher's terminal with the prescription.

## Where (verify on `main` after PR #27791 lands)

- `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/publish.ts`, step 2 (the compiled-manifest read).
- `packages/cli/src/utils/osplugin.ts`, `readOspluginManifest`.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

The publish door parses the compiled manifest through the same helper PR #27791 adds (one parse, no second copy of the rule) and refuses an invalid one before anything leaves the machine. Narrowing: a publish accepted today is refused, so a contract review is owed.

## Reach

Any `os plugin publish` of an artifact built before the `manifest-deps` retirement, or with any other compiled-manifest drift.

## Dedupe

Read the open `domain:server` titles for `plugin publish`, `osplugin`, `compiled manifest`, `ManifestSchema`: only #27686 (install and boot, its PR #27791). **New.**

Links back: #27686, PR #27791, #27123
